title: development
description: the master repository: the submodule projects, the content that powers this website, and the workstation devcontainer they are developed in.

content.heading: development - the master repository
content: development is the master repository where the software gets written: the submodule projects, the configurations and the content that power this personal website.
everything runs inside a WSL Ubuntu environment, with the repository mounted as a devcontainer.

content.heading: the devcontainer
content: a persistent Development Workstation Devcontainer for VS Code: the latest git and GitHub CLI, Node.js LTS bootstrapped through nvm, akinevz2/doftiles restored into ~/dots, and the bar, dunst, herbst, rofi, shell and vim packages stowed with `stow --adopt`.
